title: Handle an unknown path
summary: Express.js: Handle an unknown path. Visit / and compare the result.
introduction: A final middleware can reply when no earlier route matched. GET /missing reaches this fallback.
learningObjectives: Handle an unknown path with Express.js

blocks.text: In a practice folder run npm init -y and npm install express@5. Save one example as server.mjs and run node server.mjs. Use the stated URL on http://127.0.0.1:3000; stop with Ctrl+C before another example.

blocks.title: Handle an unknown path

blocks.text: No route matches /missing, so the final middleware supplies a 404 text reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Put the fallback last so it does not hide real routes.
